smtp.intro: Mail server (SMTP) the platform sends its notifications through. The password is stored encrypted and never shown.
smtp.notConfigured: No mail server has been configured yet.
smtp.demoHint: With the Docker demo profile: server mailpit, port 1025, no encryption and any user. Emails can be seen at http://localhost:8025.
smtp.hostHelp: SMTP server name or IP, for example smtp.example.com.
smtp.usernameHelp: Empty if the server does not require authentication.
smtp.passwordKeep: Stored: leave it empty to keep it

test.title: Test email
test.intro: Sends an email with the saved settings to check that the server accepts it.
test.sent: Test email sent to {{to}} through {{server}} in {{ms}} ms.
test.failed: The test email was not sent
